name: Montreal Cognitive Assessment
description: A brief cognitive screening instrument that assesses several cognitive abilities, including attention, memory, language, visuospatial skills, and executive function.
source: Identified through the cognition scoping review; retained following expert review for conceptual alignment.

name: Barthel Index
description: Measures independence in basic activities of daily living such as feeding, bathing, mobility, transfers, and toileting.
source: Identified through the functional outcome scoping review; retained following expert domain matching.

name: 36-Item Short Form Health Survey
description: A generic health-related quality-of-life questionnaire assessing physical functioning, role limitations, pain, general health, vitality, social functioning, and emotional well-being.
source: Identified through the HRQoL scoping review; mapped to multiple HRQoL subcomponents.

name: Hospital Anxiety and Depression Scale
description: A 14-item questionnaire designed to screen for symptoms of anxiety and depression in medical populations.
source: Identified through the emotions and mood scoping review; retained for further feasibility and measurement-property assessment.

name: Computed Tomography Angiography
description: An imaging technique that uses computed tomography and iodinated contrast to produce detailed images of cerebral blood vessels and assess aneurysm anatomy or occlusion.
source: Identified through the aneurysm obliteration and rebleeding evidence review; expert review pending or ongoing.

name: Computed Tomography Angiography
domain: Delayed Cerebral Ischemia and Cerebral Infarction
description: An imaging technique used to visualize cerebral blood vessels. Following aSAH, CTA can identify arterial narrowing or cerebral vasospasm that may be associated with delayed cerebral ischemia.
source: Identified through the DCI/cerebral infarction review and retained as a relevant method for assessing vasospasm.

name: Digital Subtraction Angiography
domain: Delayed Cerebral Ischemia and Cerebral Infarction
description: An invasive angiographic technique that visualizes cerebral arteries using intra-arterial contrast and digital subtraction of background structures.
source: Identified through the DCI/cerebral infarction review; retained following expert review.

name: Modified Rankin Scale
description: A global disability scale commonly used in stroke research to classify the degree of dependence in daily activities.
source: Identified through the functional outcome review and retained for further comparative assessment.

name: EuroQol 5-Dimension
description: A generic health-status measure assessing mobility, self-care, usual activities, pain/discomfort, and anxiety/depression, with an optional overall health rating.
source: Identified through the HRQoL review; retained as a candidate multidimensional HRQoL instrument.

name: Trail Making Test
construct: Processing speed, visual attention, task switching
description: A timed neuropsychological test commonly used to assess visual attention, processing speed, and aspects of executive function.
source: Identified through the cognition scoping review; status shown here for prototype purposes.
